rules: zh = a Chinese name for a code of a dimension that is no place (a fuel of siec, a sector of nrg_bal), printed on a page and marked with its name row name:zh_names:<dim>:<code>.
dims lists the dimensions this file names codes of; a code of a listed dimension with no entry has no name, and a page that would print it stops, never printing the code or an English name.
Only names the project owner reviewed are listed (zh_source 'reviewed', with the review date); a name is never machine-translated into this file.
